artigo.titulo: Why is my jade plant wrinkled or dropping leaves?

legenda: Wrinkled or falling jade leaves can mean thirst, too much water or cold. Squeeze a leaf and check the soil before you water.

beats.texto: Wrinkled leaves on your jade plant?
Don't panic! It's telling you something.
Thin, wrinkled leaves and dry soil? It's thirsty.
Soft, dark leaves and a soft stem? Too much water.
Leaves falling after a cold night? It got too cold.
Squeeze a leaf and check the soil first.
Dry right through? Water deeply, then empty the saucer.
Light and season change everything. There's an app that tells you when.
